# Sortly

> > Sortly is an inventory management software platform that helps businesses track assets, equipment, and stock using barcode scanning, QR codes, and mobile-friendly digital workflows.

Sortly provides inventory tracking solutions for industries including construction, HVAC, healthcare, electronics, manufacturing, and hospitality. The platform replaces manual Excel spreadsheets with visual, mobile-first inventory management featuring barcode/QR code scanning, custom workflows, and real-time tracking capabilities.
